content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any documents relevant to low-background requirements or spectrometer design. Extract the three allowed crystal candidates, any low-background suitability constraints, and the allowed/meaningful thickness range for each candidate."},{"id":"s2","description":"Define an initial simulation grid covering all three candidate crystals at representative thicknesses between 2 and 10 cm, including at least 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 cm where permitted. Run simulate_resolution for each crystal/thickness point and record the numeric FWHM results using record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"Analyze the initial grid results to identify, for each crystal, the thickness region giving the lowest 662 keV FWHM. Check the project-document constraints to discard any candidate that is unsuitable for low-background operation regardless of simulated resolution."},{"id":"s4","description":"For the remaining viable candidates, run a refined thickness scan around each candidate’s best grid point, using smaller thickness increments while staying within 2 to 10 cm. Record all refined FWHM results numerically with record_results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare the best recorded FWHM values across all low-background-suitable candidates. Select the crystal and thickness that achieve the lowest simulated 662 keV energy resolution while satisfying all constraints, and prepare the recommendation inputs for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Crystal-K3","thickness_cm":5.5,"justification":"Crystal-K3 at 5.5 cm is recommended because it gives the best simulated 662 keV energy resolution among all allowed candidates and tested/refined thicknesses: 2.833% FWHM. It outperforms the best refined alternatives, Crystal-K2 at 3.5 cm with 4.392% FWHM and Crystal-K1 at 5.0 cm with 8.477% FWHM. It is within the allowed 2–10 cm thickness range and was recorded as suitable for low-background operation.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 662 keV for the facility's assay programme.","status":"met","evidence":"The refined comparison found Crystal-K3 at 5.5 cm has the lowest/best resolution, 2.833% FWHM at 662 keV, compared with Crystal-K2 best 4.392% and Crystal-K1 best 8.477%."},{"requirement":"The crystal must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Candidate count is 3 and Crystal-K3 is marked as an allowed candidate."},{"requirement":"The spectrometer must be suitable for low-background operation.","status":"met","evidence":"low_background_suitable_Crystal_K3 = 1 and discard_low_background_Crystal_K3 = 0; the recommendation is also recorded as recommended_low_background_suitable = 1."},{"requirement":"Crystal thickness between 2 and 10 cm.","status":"met","evidence":"Recommended thickness is 5.5 cm, which lies within the allowed 2–10 cm range."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended crystal and thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted one recommendation: Crystal-K3 with thickness 5.5 cm."}]}
